title: Verify: interact animation emitted on an action unit tests
summary: Test App emits playAnimation on action
description: Render App with Phaser mocked, spy on reactToPhaser.emit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected bookshelf, when Inspect is clicked, then playAnimation boy interact is emitted once
Given the action, when clicked, then the story history grows
technical_constraints: Mock createGame, BootScene, phaser and ResizeObserver as tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx does

steps.symbol: new: App emits playAnimation on action
steps.action: Copy the mock header of tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx; vi.spyOn(reactToPhaser,'emit'); render App, click Begin, emit phaserToReact objectClick for 'bookshelf' inside act(), click the Inspect button, assert emit was called with 'playAnimation', { target: 'boy', name: 'interact' }.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appInteract.test.tsx
